<function name="GetSpawnEffect" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns if we should show a spawn effect on spawn on this entity.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">The flag to allow or disallow the spawn effect.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Taken from sandbox's cl_init.lua</description>
	<code>
function GM:NetworkEntityCreated( ent )

	--
	-- If the entity wants to use a spawn effect
	-- then create a propspawn effect if the entity was
	-- created within the last second (this function gets called
	-- on every entity when joining a server)
	--

	if ( ent:GetSpawnEffect() && ent:GetCreationTime() > ( CurTime() - 1.0 ) ) then
	
		local ed = EffectData()
		ed:SetEntity( ent )
		util.Effect( "propspawn", ed, true, true )

	end

end
	</code>
	<output>Checks if the entity has the spawnEffect flag set to true and checks if it was created in the last second, and then shows the propspawn effect.</output>

</example>
